name: ownlist-template
description: Serverless newsletter on your own Cloudflare account — signup, compliant one-click unsubscribe, and campaigns to your own list. Bring your own email sender.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Password that protects your send page (/admin). Use a long, random string.

FROM_NAME.description: The name your emails are sent from, e.g. "Jane's Newsletter".

FROM_EMAIL.description: The address your emails are sent from, once you connect an email provider in src/email.ts.

DOUBLE_OPT_IN.description: Set to "true" to require subscribers to confirm via a link before they're added (needs email configured). Default "false" (single opt-in).

NOTIFY_EMAIL.description: Your own address: get a short notification email whenever a subscription becomes active (needs email configured). Leave blank to disable.

SHOW_CREDIT.description: Shows a small "Powered by Ownlist" link on the public pages and in the email footer. Set to "pages" or "email" to show it only there, or "false" to hide it.

SEND_BATCH.description: Queued emails delivered per minutely background run. The default 40 fits the free plan; raise it on the paid plan or when sendEmailBatch is implemented in src/email.ts.
